`microsToUsd2dp` is defined in `web/src/lib/redis/micro-dollars.ts`. Four other files use it. I found them with a repo-wide grep that skipped `node_modules`, `.next` and `.git`.

- **`web/src/lib/admin/admin-shape.ts`**: imports it and calls it three times, at lines 41, 85 and 125. Each call converts a cost string to micros first.
- **`web/src/lib/leaderboard/window-sums-batch.ts`**: imports it and calls it at line 34 to build `cost2dp`.
- **`web/src/lib/leaderboard/assemble-board.ts`**: imports it and calls it at line 29. When the metric is `"cost"`, it converts the score.
- **`web/test/leaderboard/micro-dollars.test.ts`** (test file): imports it and tests it at lines 26–30 and 34. The tests cover rounding at the cent, half-cent rounding up, sub-cent values rounding to 0, and a round trip through `costUsdStringToMicros`.
